offer.headline: Exclusive Customer Offer

service: No-waiting policy: staff bring the order to the member
blackCard.vipRoomPrivilege: ₱2,000 less consumable on every VIP room
blackCard.validity: 1 year from the date the form is filed
blackCard.howToApply: Anytime: fill out the form and pay ₱2,200 by cash, card or bank transfer. Client wants the form digital.

functionHall.note: 'Function Room' = the 3 VIP rooms (Family, Corporate, Seminar), not a separate space

reviews.name: Nathan
reviews.text: Wow!  That's what I said after one bite of the delicious Creamy Tuscan Chicken.  Everything we ordered was exceptional.  The cheesecake was delicious too, and many choices.  This is a hidden gem.  We will be back again and again.

reviews.name: Riamaika
reviews.text: Highly recommended! The place is so beautiful, you can really feel the premium vibe. When it comes to food, 10/10 everything we ordered was delicious, especially their frappes and cakes which are really 'high quality.' Even the kids loved their menu! The ambiance is also very relaxing, perfect for some downtime. Thumbs up to all the staff because they are very accommodating. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Sittie
reviews.text: My favorite is their Blueberry Cheesecake paired with Hot Salted Caramel. Great customer service!

reviews.name: Jeff
reviews.text: You know it’s good food when you keep coming back.

reviews.name: Gyle
reviews.text: one of the best cheesecakes! must visit when in iligan!!

reviews.name: Vien
reviews.text: Amazing place with sophisticated atmosphere and yummy foods. Will visit again. Thanks for a wonderful service 👏🏻
